exposure: Women with asthma or pulmonary disease
cohort: 743 pregnant women exposed to AIT 3 months before conception up until gestational week 22, from a cohort of 924,790 singleton pregnancies in Sweden between 2005 and 2014
finding: Allergen-specific immunotherapy (AIT) during pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of congenital malformations or other adverse pregnancy outcomes.
